models: Fresh 17D MLP and LR trained on identical mixed-wide-L rows; fresh ET on the corresponding prefix rows; no prior model weights reused
MLP: 17-128-64-1; internal query holdout checkpoint selection, maximum80epochs; refit all1200 queries with selected epoch count
label: retain iff admitted_neighbors>0 OR final baseline Top10; same conservative contribution proxy as original P0
P0_A: L300; shared Vanilla/Heuristic, Static MLP, Static LR, Dynamic MLP, Dynamic LR. Static threshold calibrated retain-FNR1% on validation L300. Dynamic chosen on validation L300 under Recall>=corresponding static default. Twelve balanced six-method cyclic timing repeats; shared run pool also used by P0-B.
P0_B: Nine families: DiskANN, Heuristic, MLP, LR, DynamicMLP, DynamicLR, ET, ET_MLP, ET_LR. One shared control pool;64 configs/family, 8Lx8presets except baseline64distinctL.
dynamic_rule: score < base_tau; when zero-based rank > r AND completed_expansions > e use max(base_tau, late_tau); cache hits protected
validation: Calibrate gate thresholds on full validation L300 baseline cache-miss states; freeze64/config grids; lock per-target per-objective choices before test
test: Full frozen grid descriptive frontiers; repeat validation-selected policies and all final objective frontiers to3 repeats until stable. No test-guided grid extension.
limits: Previously inspected query split; exploratory follow-up, not an independent blind benchmark
P0-A L300 and wider mixed-L training both differ from original L100 study; not a pure queue-width causal ablation
Finite dynamic presets, not globally optimal
Candidate proxy FNR is not final Recall loss
ET trained on unpruned trajectories; joint groups may have trajectory shift
